title: 第2章 赌石（求收藏！求追读！求月票）
novel_title: 长生修仙，从装备土龙鳞开始
content_zh:
林玄盯着眼前的青色光幕，呼吸变得急促起来。

    【四阶中品灵物，土龙鳞】

    【地点：岑山坊市，九仙商盟，赌石广场，八百四十三号石】

    苦苦等了两年，终于是让他等到了。

    而且更让林玄惊喜的是，这土龙鳞竟然还是藏在一块赌石中！

    这意味着只要花费一些灵石，就能悄悄买下来！

    林玄叹了一口气，知道今晚这个觉是睡不好了。

    他索性翻身下床，取出储物袋，将里面的东西一件件摆在桌上清点了起来。

    五十一块灵石。

    两粒一阶下品养元丹，值两块灵石。

    一张一阶中品地行符，值四块灵石。

    除此之外，林玄便再无其他值钱之物。

    “灵石啊……”

    林玄喃喃自语。

    他不知道八百四十三号石究竟售价多少，只知道赌石场里石料价格不一。

    数字越大所需灵石越少。

    “八百四十三号，这个号码不算靠前，应该花不了太多灵石吧。”

    若是那块石料价格在五十一块灵石以内，他还能轻松拿下。

    但若是超过了……

    林玄眼神微微一沉。

    养元丹可以卖，地行符也可以卖，实在不行，他甚至想去找张百林借一些。

    只是其中风险......

    林玄苦笑着挠了挠头。

    一个向来连修炼资源都舍不得随意花用的人，突然拿出全部身家去梭哈赌石，已经足够引起张百林的怀疑了。

    若再去找他借钱，那便不是冒险，而是把“我有问题”四个字写在了脸上。

    所以，非到万不得已，林玄是绝对不会走这一步的。

    思量了半天也没想出什么好办法，林玄索性不想了。

    车到山前必有路，人还能被尿憋死吗？

    实在不行，哪怕去借灵石贷也要拿下。
content_en:
Lin Xuan stared at the cyan light curtain in front of him, his breathing became rapid.

    [Fourth level mid-grade spiritual object, earth dragon scale]

    [Location: Censhanfang City, Nine Immortals Merchant Alliance, Gambling Stone Plaza, Stone No. 843]

    After waiting hard for two years, he finally got it.

    What surprised Lin Xuan even more was that this earth dragon scale was actually hidden in a gambling stone!

    This means that as long as you spend some spiritual stones, you can buy it quietly!

    Lin Xuan sighed, knowing that he would not be able to sleep well tonight.

    He simply got out of bed, took out the storage bag, placed the items on the table one by one and counted them.

    Fifty-one spiritual stones.

    Two first-level low-grade Yuan Yang Pills are worth two spiritual stones.

    A first-level middle-grade earth talisman is worth four spiritual stones.

    Apart from this, Lin Xuan had nothing else of value.

    "Spiritual stone..."

    Lin Xuan murmured to himself.

    He didn't know how much the No. 843 stone cost, but he only knew that the prices of stones in the stone betting field varied.

    The higher the number, the fewer spirit stones are needed.

    "No. 843. This number is not high. It shouldn't cost too many spiritual stones."

    If the price of that stone was within fifty-one spiritual stones, he could easily win it.

    But if it exceeds...

    Lin Xuan's eyes darkened slightly.

    The Yangyuan Pill can be sold, and the Earthly Talisman can also be sold, but if that doesn't work, he even wants to borrow some from Zhang Bailin.

    It's just the risk...

    Lin Xuan smiled bitterly and scratched his head.

    A person who has always been reluctant to spend his cultivation resources suddenly used all his wealth to gamble on stones, which was enough to arouse Zhang Bailin's suspicion.

    If you go to him to borrow money again, it will not be a risk, but the words "I have a problem" will be written on your face.

    Therefore, Lin Xuan would never take this step unless absolutely necessary.

    After thinking for a long time but unable to come up with any good solution, Lin Xuan simply gave up.

    There must be a road before the car reaches the mountain. Can a person still be suffocated to death by urinating?

    If it really doesn't work, even if you want to borrow a spirit stone loan, you have to get it.
